title: Issue Review — single-pass response
description: One LLM pass for `atdd issue review` (spec §5.6 / §6.10). Each pass evaluates an ATDD parent issue across the five fixed dimensions (systemic, ambiguities, gap, regression, comprehensiveness). Per-pass files land at `.atdd/runtime/issue-reviews/<N>/pass-<i>-<llm>.json` (issue #483 runtime layout). Aggregated by `aggregate.json` (sibling schema `issue-review-aggregate.schema.json`).

pass_id.description: 1-indexed position of this pass within the run (pass `i` uses LLM `--llms[i-1]`).

llm.description: Registered LLM client id that produced this pass.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the pass completed.

dimensions.description: Per-dimension verdict and findings. Keys are the five fixed dimensions from spec §6.10.

verdict.description: `pass` = the LLM saw no concern in this dimension; `concern` = at least one finding worth surfacing.

findings.description: Findings supporting the verdict. Empty when verdict=pass; non-empty when verdict=concern.

rule_id.description: Canonical rule id from the substrate registry (resolved via `bind_rule()`); null when no registered rule maps to this finding.

severity.description: Severity 1 (informational) through 5 (blocking). Per spec §6.10 the aggregator treats systemic concerns as dominant regardless of severity.

detail.description: Free-form human-readable description of the finding.
